name: Colourful Venus Beach Retreat
subtitle: Pool & 2 Terraces
welcomeMessage: Your vibrant, colourful home with pool and two terraces, all set for you. Relax, explore, and soak up the Mediterranean. We're just a message away.

address.nearestLandmark: Behind AVLIDA Hotel, Tombs of the Kings area

checkin.keyLocation: Two key boxes on the right wall, under Post Box 'D7'. Open the one on the right.
steps: Walk to the pool area at the back of the King's Park complex
Pass the pool and turn right along the pool's fence
Turn left at the first stone arch passage
Find the two key boxes on the right wall, under the Post Box labelled 'D7'
Open the key box on the right using code 9907
Go through the corridor. The apartment is the first door on the right (ground floor)
Once inside, place the metallic key in the key plug next to the door to switch on the electricity (just like in hotels)
Return the key to the box when you check out and reset the code
checkin.notes: If you have any trouble finding us, call or WhatsApp anytime, we're happy to guide you step by step.

gettingHere.byCar: Follow the Google Maps link, it navigates directly inside the complex to the pool area. Park anywhere, then use the photo guide below to reach the apartment.
gettingHere.parking: Free parking at the pool area, spaces freely available. Apartment entrance is a 1-min walk. Avoid parking under trees on windy days.
gettingHere.publicTransport: From Paphos Airport, take Bus 612 (~35 min journey, depending on season and stops). Bus schedules on Google Maps are accurate, so you can check timings there. From the stop you have two options: walk (~18 min, 1.3 km) or hop on Bus 615 for one stop to get a bit closer, then walk the rest (~4 min). On foot: head toward the AVLIDA Hotel, walk past it, turn right at the Esso gas station, and the King's Park complex entrance is just behind it. The Google Maps location provided will take you straight into the complex. ⚠️ Buses only accept cash. €2.50 per ride per person.

directionPhotos.caption: Turn right at the Esso gas station (into Morphou street)
Go up around 50m to the big construction on the right
Keep going, just a bit more...
At this construction, turn right into the narrow street
Park here or continue on foot past the pool
Follow the road to the back where the pool area is
Turn left at the first stone arch passage
Two key boxes under Post Box 'D7'. Open the one on the right. Code: 9907
After getting the keys, walk through the passage and turn right
The first apartment on the right hand side is yours 😊

gettingHere.taxi: Taxis wait outside arrivals at Paphos Airport. Fare: €40-45 (day), €45-50 (after hours), around 20-25 minutes. A slightly cheaper option is to order a Bolt ride. If you share the Google Maps location provided with your driver, you'll be dropped right inside the complex, in front of the swimming pool.

houseRules: Please keep smoking to the balconies and terraces only
Please keep it peaceful. Quiet hours are 11pm to 8am. No parties or events
We love animals, but we're unable to accommodate pets. Sorry!
Please use the bin next to the toilet instead of flushing paper, Cyprus plumbing really can't handle it
Place the metallic key in the electricity plug by the door when you're inside, and take it with you when you leave
Close balcony and terrace doors and windows whenever the air conditioning is running, to keep things cool and save energy
Please return the keys to the keybox and reset the code when you leave. If keys are lost or locked in, a locksmith call-out will be at your cost, so do take care of them!
Please treat the apartment as your own, and let us know right away if anything gets damaged. We understand accidents happen

appliances.name: Electricity
appliances.instructions: Pop the metallic key into the plug by the door to power the apartment, and remember to take it with you when you head out. Each socket also has its own wall switch: if something isn't turning on, that's usually why. EU adapters available if needed.

appliances.name: Kitchen
appliances.instructions: Everything you need is here: electric stove, oven, air fryer, coffee maker and grinder. Salt, pepper, olive oil, and coffee beans are all yours to use. One tip: please wash dishes promptly and keep the counters clear, warm weather can attract insects.

appliances.name: Air Conditioning
appliances.instructions: The remote is on the bedside table. Press POWER and select COOL. Keep windows closed when running for best results. To turn it off, hold the power button down for a moment rather than just tapping it, and please switch off before heading out.

appliances.name: Washing Machine
appliances.instructions: Quick Wash works well for most loads. You'll find it in the kitchen.

appliances.name: Shower & Hot Water
appliances.instructions: Water is heated by solar panels on the roof, so it's warm and eco-friendly! Give it 2-3 minutes to come through, that's just the water making its way down from the panels. On overcast or cloudy days the solar may not be enough: press the boiler button next to the bathroom door and wait 20-30 minutes per person before showering. ⚠️ Always switch the boiler off before stepping in.

appliances.name: Pool Access
appliances.instructions: Your keychain includes the pool key. Please use the pool towels from the sun lounger basket rather than the bathroom ones. No glass or diving from the edge, and no pets in the pool please.

appliances.name: Bathroom
appliances.instructions: Towels, a hair dryer, and basic toiletries are all provided. Please use the bin next to the toilet rather than flushing paper, Cyprus plumbing really isn't built for it!

appliances.name: Rubbish
appliances.instructions: Rubbish bins are in the parking area on your right as you walk out past the pool.

appliances.name: Drinking Water
appliances.instructions: Tap water is safe to drink, though many guests prefer bottled. You'll find it at the nearby supermarkets.

appliances.name: Plants
appliances.instructions: If you're staying a few days, the plants would love a little water every 3-4 days. They'll appreciate it!

items.name: Venus Beach / Tombs of the Kings beach area
items.tip: Best for: closest beach, quick swim, sunset. The closest useful beach option from the apartment. Easy for a short swim without planning.

items.name: Faros Beach / Lighthouse Beach
items.distance: 2.5-3.2 km, car, bus or long walk
items.tip: Best for: sunset, casual swim, coastal walk. A nice beach and scenic walk option, but less convenient on foot than Venus Beach.

items.name: Municipal Baths, Kato Paphos
items.tip: Best for: quick dip, promenade, coffee nearby. More of a city swimming spot than a sandy beach, but practical if you're already near the harbour.

items.name: Alykes Beach, Kato Paphos
items.tip: Best for: organised beach, families, sunbeds. Easy town beach with facilities. Good for convenience rather than a remote beach feel.

items.name: Sandy Beach, Chloraka
items.tip: Best for: sunset, local feel, surfers. Less touristy option near Paphos. Better when the sea is calm.

items.name: Coral Bay Beach
items.tip: Best for: sandy beach day, swimming, families. The safest proper sandy beach recommendation near Paphos. Organised, easy, and reliable.

items.name: Laourou / Corallia Beach
items.tip: Best for: quieter sandy beach. A good alternative to Coral Bay. Similar convenience, usually calmer.

items.name: Sea Caves, Peyia
items.tip: Best for: scenic coast, photos, sunset. Not a classic beach day, but a beautiful coastal stop. Best combined with Agios Georgios or Oniro by the Sea.

items.name: Agios Georgios Beach, Peyia
items.tip: Best for: snorkelling, small beach, relaxed trip. Nice small beach area. Good to combine with Sea Caves and the Edro III Shipwreck viewpoint.

items.name: White River Beach / Toxeftra area
items.tip: Best for: wild coast, hidden gem feel. Raw and beautiful. Better for exploring than for a comfortable sunbed beach day.

items.name: Petra tou Romiou / Aphrodite's Rock
items.tip: Best for: photos, mythology, dramatic coast. Iconic scenic stop. Better for photos than swimming because it is rocky and the sea can be rough.

items.name: Lara Beach / Lara Bay
items.tip: Best for: wild beach, turtles, nature. One of the most special beaches in the Paphos area. Rough access and no proper facilities.

items.name: Latchi Harbour for Blue Lagoon boat trips
items.tip: Best for: boat trip to Blue Lagoon. Best departure point if you want Blue Lagoon without rough off-road driving.

items.name: Blue Lagoon, Akamas
items.tip: Best for: clear water, snorkelling, boat day. Getting there: car plus boat, or organised tour. Most impressive water in the wider Paphos area, but not a normal drive-up beach.

items.name: Tombs of the Kings
items.tip: Best for: ancient history, sea views, photos. The closest major historical site from the apartment. Very easy and worth visiting.

items.name: Paphos Coastal Walkway
items.tip: Best for: sea views, sunset, easy walk. One of the easiest scenic walks from the apartment. Walk towards Lighthouse Beach, the harbour and Paphos Castle.

items.name: Lighthouse Beach & Lighthouse area
items.tip: Best for: scenic walk, beach stop, sunset. A practical coastal walk with sea views. Best in the morning or before sunset.

items.name: Kato Paphos Archaeological Park
items.distance: 3-4 km, car, bus, taxi or long walk
items.tip: Best for: Roman mosaics, ruins, history lovers. One of the top cultural sites in Cyprus. Best visited in the morning during the hot months.

items.name: Paphos Harbour & Paphos Castle
items.distance: 3.5-4.5 km, car, bus, taxi or scenic walk
items.tip: Best for: harbour views, restaurants, short history stop. Good for an easy evening plan combining history, sea views, food and a relaxed walk.

items.name: Old Town Paphos & Kennedy Square
items.distance: 2-3 km, car, bus, taxi or uphill walk
items.tip: Best for: cafés, local streets, views, shopping. Nice for a cultural walk, cafés, small shops and a more local Paphos feeling. Best in the late afternoon.

items.name: Agios Neophytos Monastery
items.tip: Best for: monastery, frescoes, peaceful views. A beautiful half-day cultural stop. Quiet, scenic and more local than the main tourist sites.

items.name: Sea Caves & Edro III Shipwreck viewpoint
items.tip: Best for: scenic coast, photos, sunset. More scenic than historical, but very easy to enjoy. Combine with Oniro by the Sea, the Sea Caves and Agios Georgios.

items.name: Agios Georgios Archaeological Site, Peyia
items.tip: Best for: quiet ruins, sea views, hidden gem. A calmer alternative to the famous Paphos sites. Nice if you're already driving towards the Sea Caves or Lara.

items.name: Petra tou Romiou / Aphrodite's Rock
items.tip: Best for: mythology, dramatic coast, photos. One of the most iconic scenic stops in Cyprus. Better for views and photos than for swimming.

items.name: Akamas Peninsula scenic drive & walking stops
items.distance: 28-45 km, car, buggy or guided tour
items.tip: Best for: wild nature, walking, viewpoints. Best if you're feeling adventurous. The landscape feels much wilder than central Paphos, but road conditions vary. Distance depends on the stop.

items.name: Baths of Aphrodite
items.tip: Best for: mythology, short scenic walk, Akamas day trip. A small but pretty stop, best combined with Latchi, Polis or a Blue Lagoon boat trip.

items.name: Kourion Archaeological Site
items.tip: Best for: ancient theatre, sea views, history day trip. Excellent if you want to explore beyond Paphos. Best combined with Aphrodite's Rock or a trip towards Limassol.

items.name: Omodos Village
items.tip: Best for: traditional village, wine, mountain atmosphere. One of the prettiest village excursions from Paphos. Good for a slower cultural day trip.

items.name: Tombs of the Kings
items.tip: Best for: ancient history, photos, sea views. The closest major attraction from the apartment and easy to combine with a coastal walk.

items.name: Paphos Coastal Walkway
items.tip: Best for: sea views, sunset, easy walk. One of the easiest no-car activities from the apartment.

items.name: Kings Avenue Mall
items.distance: 1.8-2.5 km, car, bus, taxi or long walk
items.tip: Best for: shopping, food court, cinema, escaping the heat. Practical for hot, windy or rainy days.

items.name: Old Town Paphos
items.distance: 2-3 km, car, bus, taxi or uphill walk
items.tip: Best for: cafés, local shops, street art, relaxed wandering. Nice for a more local Paphos feeling. Best in the late afternoon or early evening.

items.name: Kato Paphos Archaeological Park
items.distance: 3-4 km, car, bus, taxi or long walk
items.tip: Best for: history, mosaics, ruins, culture. One of the top cultural attractions in Paphos. Best visited in the morning during the hot months.

items.name: Paphos Harbour
items.distance: 3.5-4.5 km, car, bus, taxi or scenic walk
items.tip: Best for: restaurants, boat trips, evening stroll. One of the easiest evening plans. Good for dinner, drinks and a relaxed walk by the sea.

items.name: Paphos Castle
items.distance: 3.5-4.5 km, car, bus, taxi or scenic walk
items.tip: Best for: photos, harbour views, short sightseeing. Best combined with Paphos Harbour and the coastal promenade.

items.name: Paphos Aphrodite Waterpark
items.tip: Best for: families, kids, hot days. The best family attraction nearby. An easy half-day or full-day option.

items.name: Agios Neophytos Monastery
items.tip: Best for: monastery, frescoes, peaceful views. A beautiful half-day cultural stop. Quiet, scenic and more local than the main tourist sites.

items.name: Coral Bay & Corallia Beach
items.tip: Best for: beach day, swimming, families. The easiest classic beach excursion from the apartment. Good if you want sand, sunbeds and facilities.

items.name: Horse riding in the Paphos area
items.distance: 10-25 km, car, taxi or arranged pickup
items.tip: Best for: couples, families, nature experience. A nice alternative to the beach and sightseeing. Best booked in advance. Distance depends on the provider.

items.name: Adonis Baths Waterfalls
items.distance: 15-20 km, car (not a very low one)
items.tip: Best for: nature, photos, waterfall swim. A popular excursion, but the road can be rough. Better if you're feeling adventurous.

items.name: Sea Caves & Edro III Shipwreck
items.tip: Best for: photos, sunset, dramatic coastline. A very easy scenic excursion from Paphos. Great with a stop at Oniro by the Sea.

items.name: Paphos Zoo
items.tip: Best for: families with children. A popular family attraction near Coral Bay and Peyia. Easy to combine with the Sea Caves or Coral Bay.

items.name: Wine villages around Kathikas
items.tip: Best for: wine tasting, local villages, food. Great for adults who want a more local experience. Better with a tour if everyone wants to taste the wine.

items.name: Avakas Gorge
items.tip: Best for: hiking, nature, adventure. One of the best nature walks in the Paphos region. Wear proper shoes and avoid it after heavy rain or in extreme heat.

items.name: Akamas Jeep Safari
items.tip: Best for: adventure, wild nature, viewpoints. Best if you want an adventure without driving the difficult roads yourself. Distance depends on the route.

items.name: Polis & Latchi
items.tip: Best for: harbour lunch, relaxed day trip, boat trips. A calmer side of Cyprus compared with central Paphos. Good for lunch, a coastal walk and Blue Lagoon departures.

items.name: Blue Lagoon boat trip from Latchi
items.tip: Best for: clear water, snorkelling, boat day. Getting there: car plus boat, or organised tour. One of the best full-day excursions from Paphos. You'll love it if you enjoy swimming and boat trips.

items.name: Baths of Aphrodite
items.tip: Best for: mythology, short walk, Akamas day trip. Nice to combine with Latchi, the Blue Lagoon and Polis. On its own, it's a small stop.

items.name: Kourion Archaeological Site
items.tip: Best for: history, sea views, day trip towards Limassol. Excellent if you want to explore beyond Paphos. The theatre and coastal views are the highlights.

items.name: Omodos Village
items.tip: Best for: traditional village, wine, mountain atmosphere. One of the prettiest village excursions from Paphos. Works well as part of a Troodos or wine-route day.

items.name: Limassol Marina & Old Town
items.tip: Best for: city day trip, marina, restaurants. More urban and polished than Paphos. Best combined with Kourion or Omodos.

items.name: Troodos Mountains & villages
items.tip: Best for: mountain villages, monasteries, cooler weather. The best full-day excursion if you want a break from the coast and the summer heat. Distance depends on the route.

items.name: Tombs of the Kings coastal loop
items.tip: Difficulty: Easy. Best for: history plus sea views. The closest easy walk from the apartment, combining open landscape, coastline and ancient tombs.

items.name: Paphos Coastal Walkway
items.tip: Difficulty: Easy. Best for: sea views, sunset, casual walk. The best no-car option. Walk towards Lighthouse Beach, the harbour and Paphos Castle.

items.name: Lighthouse Beach coastal walk
items.tip: Difficulty: Easy. Best for: short scenic walk, sunset, sea breeze. Good if you want nature without a proper hike.

items.name: Sea Caves coastal walk, Peyia
items.tip: Difficulty: Easy to moderate. Best for: sea cliffs, photos, sunset. One of the easiest scenic nature outings by car. Combine with the Edro III Shipwreck and Oniro by the Sea.

items.name: Avakas Gorge Nature Trail
items.tip: Difficulty: Moderate. Best for: gorge, dramatic rock walls, adventure. Probably the best nature trail near Paphos. Wear proper shoes and avoid it after heavy rain or in extreme heat.

items.name: Lara Beach & Toxeftra coastal area
items.tip: Difficulty: Moderate. Best for: wild coast, turtles, remote nature. Beautiful but not polished. Better if you're feeling adventurous. Access roads can be rough, and please respect the turtle nesting areas.

items.name: Smigies Nature Trail, Neo Chorio
items.tip: Difficulty: Moderate. Best for: forest, Akamas views, shorter hike. Good if you want Akamas scenery but something less demanding than the Aphrodite or Adonis trails.

items.name: Baths of Aphrodite short walk
items.tip: Difficulty: Easy. Best for: mythology, greenery, light walking. Good if you want a gentle nature stop rather than a real hike. Best combined with Latchi or a Blue Lagoon boat trip.

items.name: Aphrodite Nature Trail, Akamas
items.tip: Difficulty: Moderate to hard. Best for: Akamas views, coastline, proper hiking. One of the most beautiful hikes in the Paphos region. It starts near the Baths of Aphrodite and gives wide views over Polis, Latchi and Akamas.

items.name: Adonis Nature Trail, Akamas
items.tip: Difficulty: Moderate to hard. Best for: views, nature, quieter hiking. A good alternative to the Aphrodite Trail. Best if you want a proper Akamas hike and are comfortable with a more active route.

items.name: Aphrodite's Rock coastal viewpoint walk
items.tip: Difficulty: Easy. Best for: photos, mythology, dramatic coast. Not a long hike, but a very scenic stop. Good if you're driving towards Limassol or the airport.

items.name: Troodos Nature Trails
items.tip: Difficulty: Easy to hard. Best for: forest, mountains, cooler weather. The best full-day hiking option, especially in summer when the coast is too hot. Troodos is better for real forest trails and cooler air. Distance depends on the trail.

items.tip: One of the best scenic spots in the Paphos area. Combine with Sea Caves and Edro III shipwreck.

items.name: Kathikas wine village restaurants

items.name: Latchi Harbour tavernas

items.name: AlphaMega

items.name: Lidl Paphos, Tombs of the Kings Road

items.name: Kings Avenue Mall services

items.name: Kennedy Square & Makarios Avenue
items.distance: 2-3 km, car, bus, taxi or uphill walk
items.tip: Best for: main Old Town shopping area, cafés, clothes, jewellery. A good central starting point for Old Town shopping.

items.name: Paphos Municipal Market / Old Market
items.distance: 2-3 km, car, bus, taxi or uphill walk
items.tip: Best for: local products, souvenirs, small gifts, relaxed morning. Best if you want something more Cypriot than mall shopping.

items.name: Ibrahim's Khan / Old Town craft area
items.distance: 2-3 km, car, bus, taxi or uphill walk
items.tip: Best for: crafts, design, Old Town atmosphere. A nice add-on if you're already visiting the Old Town. Better for wandering and small finds than serious shopping.

items.name: Paphos fruit & local produce market area
items.distance: 2-3 km, car, bus, taxi or uphill walk
items.tip: Best for: fruit, local produce, food souvenirs. Good if you love food.

items.name: Papantoniou Supermarket, Paphos
items.tip: Best for: groceries, household basics, local supermarket. Useful for a bigger grocery shop. More practical than touristy. Distance depends on the branch.

items.name: Paphos Harbour souvenir shops
items.distance: 3.5-4.5 km, car, bus, taxi or scenic walk
items.tip: Best for: souvenirs, beach items, tourist gifts. Convenient if you're already going for dinner or a harbour walk. More touristy, but easy.

items.name: Jumbo Paphos
items.tip: Best for: beach items, toys, home items, cheap practical things. Good for families: beach toys, chargers, towels and basic home and travel items. Not central, but useful.

items.name: Paphos Airport duty free
items.distance: 17-20 km, car, taxi or airport transfer
items.tip: Best for: last-minute gifts, cosmetics, alcohol. Fine for last-minute purchases, but I wouldn't rely on it for proper shopping. Better to buy gifts in town.

items.name: Polis & Latchi small shops
items.tip: Best for: day-trip shopping, small local shops, harbour souvenirs. Only worth it if you're already going to Latchi, Polis, the Blue Lagoon or Akamas.

shopping.tip: The main shopping mall in Paphos. Wide range of shops, restaurants and a cinema.

shopping.name: Paphos Market
shopping.tip: Covered marketplace with stalls for clothing, bags, jewelry, beach gear and local souvenirs.

shopping.name: Old Town
shopping.tip: Wander through the beautiful Old Town and discover many small boutique stores and artisan shops.

gettingAround.name: Bus
gettingAround.info: Central bus station (Tombs of the Kings) is 18 min walk (~1.3 km) away, with direct connections to main attractions, the airport, and nearby towns. Bus stops have recently been added to Google Maps too, though always worth checking against the official website for the latest timetables.

gettingAround.name: RideNow (Car Sharing)
gettingAround.info: Car-sharing app that works well around Paphos. Sign up in minutes. Cars typically within a 5-10 min walk.

gettingAround.name: Bolt
gettingAround.info: Budget-friendly ride app. Good alternative to metered taxis around Paphos.

gettingAround.name: Taxi
gettingAround.info: Various taxi services are available online. One reliable option is Paphos Taxi Airport, where you can also arrange a pickup directly via WhatsApp: +357 99 460 829.

contacts.name: Emergency Services
contacts.note: Police, Ambulance, Fire. Free from any phone

steps: If you could give any dishes a quick wash and leave them on the drying rack, that would be great!
If you could clear out the fridge and pop any leftover food in the bin, we'd appreciate it!
If you could take the rubbish bags to the bins in the parking area, on your right as you walk out past the pool, that would be a big help!
If it's raining or looks like rain is on the way, please bring the outdoor sofa cushions back inside so they stay dry. Thank you!
Before heading off, please lock all windows, balcony doors and shutters.
Please switch off all lights, AC, and the TV when you're done.

steps.text: When you're ready to go, please lock up and return all keys to the keybox, resetting the code after.
steps.imageAlt: How to place the key back in the keybox

steps: Drop us a WhatsApp to let us know you've left, and we'd truly love a review if you enjoyed your stay!
